allow: Bash(find . -name "__init__.py" -not -path "./.venv/*" -exec sh -c 'if [ ! -s ""$1"" ]; then echo ""EMPTY: $1""; else echo ""HAS CONTENT: $1""; fi' _ {} ;)

hooks.command: python -c "import sys,json,datetime,os; data=json.load(sys.stdin); sid=data.get('session_id','unknown')[:8]; os.makedirs('traces',exist_ok=True); entry={'event':'pre','tool':data.get('tool_name',''),'input':data.get('tool_input',{}),'session':data.get('session_id',''),'ts':datetime.datetime.now().isoformat()}; f=open(f'traces/hooks-{sid}.jsonl','a',encoding='utf-8'); f.write(json.dumps(entry)+'\n'); f.close()"

python -c "import sys,json,datetime,os; data=json.load(sys.stdin); sid=data.get('session_id','unknown')[:8]; os.makedirs('traces',exist_ok=True); output=str(data.get('tool_output',''))[:500]; entry={'event':'post','tool':data.get('tool_name',''),'input':data.get('tool_input',{}),'output_preview':output,'session':data.get('session_id',''),'ts':datetime.datetime.now().isoformat()}; f=open(f'traces/hooks-{sid}.jsonl','a',encoding='utf-8'); f.write(json.dumps(entry)+'\n'); f.close()"
